review_method: Assistant visual inspection of 5 chronological samples per hook and selected B-roll interval, including first and last selected source frames. Not an exhaustive frame or audible playback audit.

hook_findings.H1: Stable four-panel designer-bag layout; walking in left panels and restrained camera movement in right panels. No Eleanor or writing in reviewed samples.
hook_findings.H2: Distinct chocolate, ivory, navy and gray bags, coherent clothing and gentle bag movement; no writing in reviewed samples.
hook_findings.H3: Travel contexts remain distinct; left walking/luggage, right hotel/train; four bags maintained; no text in reviewed samples.

body_findings.C01: Front sofa product reveal with horizontal oval hardware and canvas/cognac construction.
body_findings.C02: Visible lift beside suitcase; supports travel use without a fit claim.
body_findings.C03: Hand on handles by mirror; styling action, not a before-after comparison.
body_findings.C04: Full front hand-held shape and handles.
body_findings.C05: Hardware and canvas close view; keep <=1.5s before later source dissolve.
body_findings.C06: Folded shirt and sunglasses visible beside product.
body_findings.C09: Bag lifts from entry bench, clear literal action.
body_findings.C10: Side-view walking payoff; distinct from pickup shot.
body_findings.C12: Rear/three-quarter doorway departure, distinct from side walk.
body_findings.C13: Angled bag on entry bench; supports clean end hold.

variety: Ten unique source clips with distinct approved actions/framing. Same model, outfit and room palette recur deliberately; no source repeats within an ad. C01/C05/C06 are related product views but change detail and explanatory purpose.
scale: Reference-relative appearance only; physical 18-inch dimensions not verifiable.
remaining: Full source-interval playback/text check, avatar lip-sync review, composited placement/key-edge review and Resolve export QA.
